name: Skandic
summary: Quiet Nordic single-property rental site in pale grey and white with light Switzer headlines that fade to grey on the second line, a slide-scrolling cabin hero and numbered chapter labels.

fonts.pairing: single neo-grotesk: 300 light for large headings with a grey second line, 400 to 500 for body, tiny uppercase chapter labels

signature: two-tone headlines where the second clause drops to mid grey
full-bleed hero that steps through three slides with numbered progress bars along the bottom
numbered chapter labels like 01 with a short dash before every section
white stat cards with oversized light numerals for capacity, size, year and price
imagery: moody Nordic cabin architecture, fjords and snowy peaks, dark wood interiors with warm lamp light, overcast cool grade
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 12-column grid, generous 120 to 160px section spacing, 8px card radius
